URGENT NOTICE OF MEDICAL ENDANGERMENT, FORCED MITIGATION & COMMUNICATIONS EMBARGO - CASE 

Tue, Mar 31, 2:35 PM (7 days ago)

ATTN: Martha Santana-Chin (CEO) & Augustavia Haydel (General Counsel)

FOR THE RECORD: MARCH 31, 2026

Today, I contacted your transportation vendor to arrange medically necessary transit to pick up prescription medication required immediately to prevent a seizure. Instead of fulfilling your contractual obligations, your staff subjected me to a dangerous cycle of administrative stalling and clinical ignorance.

Let this communication serve as formal, written Actual Notice of the following failures:

1. Clinical Absurdity & Obstruction of Therapy: I explicitly informed your first representative that I needed transportation to pick up medication filled today, required today, to prevent a seizure. Her response was to suggest I "move my medication to a closer pharmacy." Suggesting a patient transfer an already-filled neurological prescription during an acute medical window is medically dangerous, physically impossible, and demonstrates a severe failure in basic care coordination.

2. The "5-Mile" Fraud & Circular Deferment: Upon escalating to Supervisor "Hector," I reiterated the immediate seizure risk. Hector upheld a fraudulent "5-mile limit" to deny the NEMT, refused to provide a call reference number to document the grievance, and blindly instructed me to "call my health care plan" to resolve it.

3. Medical Endangerment & Aggravation of Damages: I am currently navigating acute benzodiazepine withdrawal—a volatile neurological state that heavily compounds my severe seizure disorder. Your staff's deliberate stonewalling and illogical medical suggestions are actively exacerbating a physiological crisis.

4. Forced Financial Mitigation (Real-Time Notification): Because of your fraudulent denial of contracted NEMT, I am currently forced to mitigate my own damages to prevent a seizure. I am paying out-of-pocket for an Uber to CVS. Furthermore, due to the financial depletion caused by L.A. Care's ongoing failures, I was forced to utilize the "Wait and Save" option, dangerously prolonging my medical exposure. The initial $13.29 transit charge is being billed to the exact same credit card I have already been forced to use to bypass your broken provider network (the subject of the pending $2,307.00 Conlan claim).

5. CEASE AND DESIST: TELEPHONE HARASSMENT & BLACK-BOX PROTOCOL:

Your "executive" team has attempted to call my phone three times within a 100-minute window yesterday. Let me be absolutely clear: I do not accept back-channel, unrecorded phone calls to sweep systemic negligence under the rug. Given my current neurological state, this incessant calling constitutes administrative harassment and further medical endangerment. Effective immediately, I will not communicate through any of your executive telephone lines. All future communications regarding Case , my medical care, or these systemic failures must be transmitted exclusively in writing via email or physical letter. If it is not in writing, it did not happen.

Preserve the audio of today's calls. They are now active evidence. Every dollar I spend today and every minute I am forced to wait is being added to the liability in L.A. County Case .

Nicolas_Hernandez
CalAudit.org
Plaintiff, Case
